title: 第19章 温和待人尊老爱幼顾清秋懵了第20章 斩杀命轮境凶兽何须配合
slug: 玄幻长生神子何须妹骨证道
content_zh:
顾青挥袖，“开始吧。”
下一刻。
虚空秘境广场上，数千道令牌开始散发光辉，一众长生顾家子弟开始按照光辉指引，走到自已号牌指引所在的区域。
顾长歌、顾元，顾霜剑等序列子弟并不需要行动，依旧站在原地。
而顾清秋也没有行动。
这一次她只是跟随顾长歌观礼，出手不会算入队伍积分，也没有得到令牌。
顾青身边的六位修为高超的族老，目光落在顾长歌以及顾清秋身上。
一位族老道：“家主，顾清秋身怀至尊骨，让她直接跟在神子身边进入虚空秘境，是不是有点不妥？”
“不错，虚空秘境虽说没有十分强大的凶兽鬼怪，但如果出现意外，那我长生顾家可就损失一名拥有至尊骨的绝世妖孽了。”
又一位族老开口。
顾青闻言神色平静，俯瞰和顾长歌站在一起的顾清秋，淡淡道：“无妨，长歌自有打算，而且我们看着，还能出现什么意外吗？”
“虚空秘境早些时日不是出现动荡了吗？不怕一万就怕万一。”
第三名族老叹了口气说。
“不会，况且清秋既然和长歌一起来，想必长歌已经问过她，她也同意了。”
“好吧。”
顾青这么说，一众族老也不好继续说什么了。
至于年龄不够，不能进入？
那只不过层次还没有达到践踏规则的地步而已。
哪怕长生顾家是高高在上，俯瞰红尘的长生世家，可内部依旧有贵贱之分，普天之下，何处不是。
……

很快队伍便已经分好，总计十个队伍，完美杜绝了一些人想要跟在强大序列背后的想法。
“长歌，抽取号牌吧。”
一团灵光飘落在顾长歌等人眼前。
顾长歌没有迟疑，伸手朝面前的一团灵光抓去。
下一刻，灵光变成一枚白玉令牌，令牌上刻画着一个十分显眼的10字，显然顾长歌接下来将会执掌第10队入虚空秘境进行成人礼试炼。
在顾长歌抽取时，背后十支队伍的长生顾家子弟，全部屏息凝神，等待顾长歌抽取结果揭晓。
当看到顾长歌执掌十队时，整个十队的长生顾家子弟齐齐欢呼狂笑。
而没有被顾长歌抽取到的队伍，顾家子弟则是十分失落。
不过他们很快就强打精神，失落也没用，既然不得神子提携，除了神子之外，第二序列第三序列的顾元，顾霜剑也不差。
很快。
顾元，顾霜剑二人也抽取完号牌。
不知道是不是机缘巧合，两人抽取的队伍号牌，竟然和他们序列排名一样，竟然也是第二，第三支队伍，这让这两支队伍的顾家子弟兴奋欢呼不已。
一刻钟后。
顾青看着十支队伍前尽皆站着的九位序列，一神子，满意点头：“好，尔等现在可自由进入虚空秘境，令牌有护命功效，有危险将会被遣送出虚空秘境，届时积分锁定，等结束之后会进行个人排名编册，好了，进去吧。”
一支支队伍进入虚空秘境。
content_en:
Gu Qing waved his sleeves and said, "Let's get started."
The next moment.
In the void secret square, thousands of tokens began to emit light, and the disciples of the Immortal Gu family began to follow the guidance of the light and walk to the area where their number plates guided them.
Gu Changge, Gu Yuan, Gu Shuangjian and other disciples did not need to move and remained standing where they were.
And Gu Qingqiu didn't take any action.
This time she just followed Gu Changge to watch the ceremony, and her actions would not be counted as team points, nor would she get a token.
The six highly skilled clan elders beside Gu Qing focused their attention on Gu Changge and Gu Qingqiu.
An elder said: "Master, Gu Qingqiu is pregnant with the Supreme Bone. Isn't it a bit inappropriate for her to follow the Son of God directly into the secret realm of the void?"
"Yes, although there are no very powerful beasts and ghosts in the Void Secret Realm, if something unexpected happens, my Immortal Gu family will lose a peerless monster with the Supreme Bone."
Another clan elder spoke.
Gu Qing looked calm when he heard this. He looked down at Gu Qingqiu who was standing with Gu Changge and said calmly: "It doesn't matter, Changge has his own plan, and we are watching, can any accidents happen?"
"Didn't the Void Secret Realm experience turmoil earlier? Don't be afraid of ten thousand, just be afraid of the worst."
The third clan elder sighed and said.
"No, besides, since Qingqiu came with Changge, Changge must have asked her and she agreed."
"Okay."
When Gu Qing said this, all the clan elders could not continue to say anything.
As for not being old enough to enter?
That's just that the level hasn't reached the point of trampling the rules.
Even though the Changsheng Gu family is a high-altitude Changsheng family, overlooking the world of mortals, there is still a distinction between high and low in the world.
…
The teams were quickly divided, with a total of ten teams, which perfectly eliminated the idea of ​​some people wanting to follow behind the powerful sequence.
"Changge, let's draw the number plate."
A ball of spiritual light fell in front of Gu Changge and others.
Gu Changge didn't hesitate and reached out to grab the aura in front of him.
The next moment, the aura turned into a white jade token, with a very conspicuous number 10 engraved on it. Obviously, Gu Changge will take charge of the 10th team to enter the void secret realm for the coming-of-age ceremony trial.
When Gu Changge was drawing, the descendants of the Changsheng Gu family in the ten teams behind him all held their breaths and waited for the announcement of Gu Changge's drawing results.
When they saw Gu Changge taking charge of the tenth team, the entire tenth team of Changsheng Gu family members cheered and laughed wildly.
As for the team that was not selected by Gu Changge, the children of the Gu family were very disappointed.
However, they quickly cheered up, and it was useless to be disappointed. Since they were not supported by the Son of God, in addition to the Son of God, Gu Yuan and Gu Shuangjian, who were in the second and third sequences, were also not bad.
soon.
Gu Yuan and Gu Shuangjian also finished drawing numbers.
I don't know if it was a coincidence, but the team numbers they drew were the same as theirs, and they were also the second and third teams. This made the Gu family members of these two teams cheer excitedly.
A quarter of an hour later.
Gu Qing looked at the nine-digit sequence standing in front of the ten teams, one god, and nodded with satisfaction: "Okay, you can now freely enter the Void Secret Realm. The token has the effect of protecting your life. If you are in danger, you will be sent out of the Void Secret Realm. The points will be locked at that time. After the end, personal rankings will be compiled. Okay, let's go in."
Team after team entered the secret realm of the void.
